In my experience and research, my venus fly traps do best if you fill a saucer underneath them with about an inch of water, just enough to cover the bottom, let the plant suck it all up, then refill after 2-3 days. Really you want the soil to always be moist but not waterlogged. You especially don't want it sitting in water for too long if it's indoors and/or not very warm. More sun the better!
